items.title: High-throughput enterprise-scale document migration on AWS
items.summary: Migrating hundreds of millions of documents to the cloud is a defining enterprise challenge – data loss, downtime, or compliance gaps break traditional approaches. Here’s how we built a system on AWS that migrated 800 million documents with configurable parallelism, self-healing, and integrity validation. When migrating at this scale, traditional approaches quickly break down. Manual […]
